description: The European Central Bank's Data Portal publishes payments statistics for the euro area and EU member states in the Payments transactions (key indicators) dataset, PAY, with about 78,000 series. Series cover payment transactions by instrument and channel, such as total payments, cheques and money remittances, with country breakdowns for each EU member state and aggregates for the euro area and the EU in changing composition, at annual, half-yearly and quarterly frequency. The portal offers filtering by concept, area, dataset and frequency, dashboards, release calendars (for example TARGET balance statistics) and explanatory articles, and data can be viewed and downloaded free of charge. The licence or reuse terms were not read on the pages opened. Caveats: series lengths differ by country and values are national aggregates. For simulation it gives the volume and value of payments by instrument across Europe, a baseline for disruption impact on card, transfer and cash use. Related catalogue records include the BIS CPMI Red Book statistics and the Federal Reserve Payments Study.
